scientific_question: Can the same nominal structure be distinguished from different DFT settings and structure snapshots when comparing MP, OQMD and local PyMatGen results?

si.structural_reason: Both official records label the diamond-cubic Si structure Fd-3m

gaas.structural_reason: Both official records label the zinc-blende GaAs structure F-43m

sio2.structural_reason: MP labels P3_121 while OQMD labels P3121; these are notation variants of the same trigonal phase, not different material IDs

rules.id_spaces: MP material_id, OQMD native entry_id and OQMD OPTIMADE structure id are recorded separately and never assumed interchangeable
rules.density: Recompute from the OQMD OPTIMADE lattice and Cartesian species positions using PyMatGen Structure.density; compare but do not force equality with MP's structure-specific density
rules.space_group: Recompute with SpacegroupAnalyzer symprec=0.1; preserve enantiomer and notation differences
rules.band_gap: Compare DFT values without treating experimental gaps as an error-free reference or declaring one DFT implementation fraudulent
rules.stability: Keep MP energy_above_hull and OQMD stability/delta_e fields separate; do not infer identical convex-hull references
rules.failures: Network failure, missing structure or inconsistent species/site counts is unresolved, never a successful verification
rules.interpretation: Verified means the explicit local computations and source checks completed, not experimental validation, a new material discovery or proof of universal DFT accuracy

prohibitions: No assignment of one universal band gap or density to all structures with the same formula
No claim that a difference between MP and OQMD is automatically an error
No use of the small three-material sample as a global DFT benchmark
No merging of MP and OQMD identifiers into a fabricated canonical ID
